BATTLE-SPIRITS-A15151.name: ［Rainbow Colored Wits］Kirika
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A15151.effect:
[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate attacks)
Refresh a Spirit you control. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, by paying one cost, depending on the number of "Diva" family Spirits you control, activate one of the following effects:
*2 or more: Return an opposing braved Brave to the deckbottom.
*3 or more: Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom.
*4 or more: Return an opposing Ultimate to the deckbottom.
*6 or more: Send an opposing Life to the Void.
